subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A wet blanket

options.text: A person who spoils other people's fun

solution:
The correct answer is** 'A person who spoils other people's fun.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom **'a wet blanket' **is a person who says or does something that stops other people from enjoying themselves.
 
• Idiom 'a wet blanket' का अर्थ एक ऐसा व्यक्ति है जो ऐसा कुछ कहता या करता है जो अन्य लोगों को स्वयं का आनंद लेने से रोकता है।
 
 
• **Example**: *He was such **a wet blanket **at the party that they never invited him again.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is **a person who spoils other people's fun**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• A **wet blanket **is someone who spoils the enjoyment of a situation, someone who dampens other people's joy.
 
• The expression dates from around the 1870s and is based on the fact that cooks at that time kept a wet blanket in the kitchen to smother fires quickly.
 
• This practice dates back at least to the mid-1600s.
